title: San Francisco Bay Cruise, Muir Woods and Sausalito Combo Tour
includes: Entrance fee to Muir Woods National Monument, $15
The City tour is in English, Bay cruise in 8 languages with Wi-Fi enabled device
Ticket to 60 minute SF Bay Cruise $28-$39
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Two Great Activities in One Day! 
Join us for a narrated and scenic drive from SF across Golden Gate Bridge! Stop at the Bridge to take pictures!
Explore beauty of Richardson Bay, Marin County, Mount Tamalpais and Giant Coastal Redwoods at Muir Woods!
Appreciate astonishing views from Sausalito's picturesque waterfront!
Visit local Art Galleries and souvenir shops and eat in one of many seafood restaurants!
After visiting Muir Woods & Sausalito, our driver/guide
will bring you to Fisherman's Wharf by 1 PM, giving you time to walk around or have lunch before the Cruise. The Bay Cruise starts at 
2:45 
4:15 
5:30 
and you can choose your preferred time while booking. 
During the 60-minute cruise by The Blue & Gold Fleet, you will sail underneath the majestic Golden Gate Bridge, past the famous PIER 39 sea lions, around mysterious Alcatraz and along SF waterfront, revealing the city’s skyline. 
The boats have both indoor and outdoor seating with full narration describing major landmarks.
